note: Real site layouts from OpenStreetMap, normalised into the street frame of the site (u along the street, to the right when facing the site; v away from the street, v = 0 on the street centreline; metres). The generator fits one to a target building: it may mirror u, scale within the measured ranges of siteProfile.json, and shift v to the target road's real kerb line (road.hwAssumed is the half-width this study assumed). Every template lists its source town and OSM element ids for the ODbL credit.
